title: finding(plugin-charts,plugin-dashboard): `object-chart`, `object-pivot` and `object-data-table` accept `DrillDownConfig` members they never read — the sibling blocks of objectui#9002
body:
Filing-gate category: ③ a trap: declared members the renderer never reads, accepted with no diagnostic (class c). This is the per-block sibling of objectui#9002, whose ruling (`5643445104`, B, a per-block refusal; maintainer 「其他同意」) set the pattern for `object-metric`. Reader: triage first (route and grade; per the family rule it may reuse objectui#9002's ruling rather than open a new decision, unless it finds a real semantic difference), then the seat that claims it. Dedupe: objectui issues and PRs updated since 2026-09-19 (1000 walked, open and closed), plus all 187 open issues: `drillDown\.mode` → 2 (objectui#9002, PR objectui#10681), `(object-data-table|ObjectDataTable).{0,120}drillDown` → 3 (those two, plus closed objectui#7353, which is about `dataProvider`), `DrillDownConfig` → 2 (the same two), `drillDown.{0,120}(maxRows|report).{0,80}(data.table|ObjectDataTable)` → 0. In the open walk, `drillDown` → 5: those two, objectui#8071 (a per-block member-pin census, not a refusal), objectui#6152 and objectui#4044 (other keys). No card carries this.

Filed by the `domain:ui` execution seat (seat 1, session `session_01BA3nKVUwKQJf8DBxrSVtNC`) from the `os-dev-report` of objectui#9002 (PR objectui#10681), which measured it and left it by scope. The seat re-read every site on objectui `origin/main` `d08ab2fc8`. ⛔ Not graded and not routed.

## The shape

The shared `DrillDownConfig` (`packages/types/src/data-display.ts`) declares `enabled`, `filter`, `title`, `mode`, `target` (`drawer` | `dialog` | `navigate`), `columns`, `report` and `maxRows`. objectui#9002 refuses `filter` and `mode` on `object-metric` by name, because the metric can never honour them. The other three blocks that take the shared type each leave some members unread:

| block | reads (seat's grep of `drillDown` in the renderer) | declared, never read |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `object-chart` (`plugin-charts/src/ObjectChart.tsx`) | `isDrillEnabled`, `computeDrillFilter` (`filter`), `resolveDrillTitle`, `target` (including `navigate`), `maxRows`, `columns` | `mode`, `report` |
| `object-pivot` (`plugin-dashboard/src/ObjectPivotTable.tsx`) | `isDrillEnabled`, `computeDrillFilter` (`filter`), `resolveDrillTitle`, `target`, `columns`, `maxRows`, `report` | `mode` |
| `object-data-table` (`plugin-dashboard/src/ObjectDataTable.tsx`) | `isDrillEnabled`, `mode`, a non-template `title`, `columns`, and `target` in two arms only (`dialog` ⇒ dialog, anything else ⇒ drawer) | `filter`, `maxRows`, `report`; `target: 'navigate'` is accepted and silently drawn as a drawer |

Two more readings in the same family:

- The `DrillDownConfig.mode` docblock names "charts, pivot tables and metric cards" as users of the `'filter'` mode. None of the three reads `mode`.
- The runtime door accepts these members on stored metadata: the zod mirror's `ObjectDataTableSchema.drillDown` and `ChartSchema.drillDown` are both `DrillDownConfigSchema`, which admits every member. (The spec's own `ChartDrillDownSchema` already refuses `mode` on the chart.)

⇒ An author, or an AI, who writes `drillDown.filter` on a data table or `drillDown.mode` on a chart gets a green parse and a block that ignores the key, with no diagnostic. On the data table, `target: 'navigate'` is the sharpest case, because the author asked to leave the dashboard and gets a drawer.

## Direction (for triage, ⛔ not a ruling)

objectui#9002's ruling B is the family's answer for `object-metric`: refuse the members a block can never honour, per block, and keep the shared type whole. Whether each unread member here is "can never honour" (refuse) or "should honour" (implement, e.g. `navigate` on the data table, or `maxRows` on its drawer) is the per-member question triage or the ruling owes. ⛔ This card does not pick.
